adversarial_source_review.broken_app_considered: A static or localStorage-only save that shows the expected numbers cannot meet the constraints gate: it must first save novel UI-created requisition and offer identities and then reveal those same values in a fresh empty authenticated context. The protocol rejects a same-context reload, fake HTTP200 or requisition-only app. This is a source-level counterexample assessment, not a measured app score.
adversarial_source_review.conforming_alternative_considered: A compliant app starting with empty operational history, generating UUID record IDs, omitting optional separate title/department fields, and using different routes remains admissible under instruction.md and constraints/judge.toml. Prompts discover actual requests and accept equivalent date/money representations; no mechanical contract rejects this alternative.
